CvmOperationPhase.title: CvmOperationPhase
CvmOperationPhase.description:
Persisted phase of an in-progress CVM operation.

Common shutdown flow and operation-specific continuations::

    QUEUED -> INIT
                |
                +-- already stopped -------------------------------> CONTINUE
                |
                +-- explicit force / unhealthy precheck
                |       |
                |       +-> WAIT_STOPPED_FORCE -- stopped ---------> CONTINUE
                |
                +-- healthy precheck
                        |
                        +-> WAIT_STOPPED_GRACEFUL
                                |
                                +-- stopped ------------------------> CONTINUE
                                |
                                +-- unhealthy / timeout
                                        |
                                        +-> WAIT_STOPPED_FORCE
                                                |
                                                +-- stopped --------> CONTINUE

    CONTINUE
        +-- UPDATE -----> APPLY_UPDATE -----------+
        +-- COMPOSE ----> UPDATING_COMPOSE -------+-> WAIT_RUNNING -> complete
        +-- VISIBILITY -> UPGRADE_COMPOSE --------+
        +-- RESIZE -----> RESIZE -----------------+
        +-- RESTART -----------------------------------------------> WAIT_RUNNING -> complete
        +-- SHUTDOWN -------------------------------------------------------------> complete
        +-- REMOVE -----> DESTROY ------------------------------------------------> complete

app_id.description: Optional app_id for manual specification. Required when nonce is provided. Only works with PHALA KMS.

env_keys.title: Env Keys
env_keys.description: Allowed encrypted environment variable names. When compose_file does not declare allowed_envs, or sends an empty list, these names populate compose_file.allowed_envs for the guest allowlist.

skip_gateway.title: Skip Gateway
skip_gateway.description: Deploy without dstack-gateway. Turns the gateway off in compose_file when it does not set gateway_enabled/tproxy_enabled; rejected when compose_file enables the gateway.

key_provider_mode.title: Key Provider Mode
key_provider_mode.description: Key provider mode. 'local' enables the local key provider in compose_file (and turns off KMS and the gateway where compose_file does not set them); rejected when compose_file sets key_provider or local_key_provider_enabled the other way.

init_scripts.title: Init Scripts
init_scripts.description: Platform-owned init scripts to run on every boot, as slugs: docker_cleanup erases all local container-runtime stores (images, volumes, all containerd namespaces) and needs OS 0.6.x, ext4 storage and the docker-compose runner; env_merge merges encrypted env on boot, needs OS 0.6.0 or newer and the managed_env_create feature flag. Phala Cloud fixes the run order (docker_cleanup, then env_merge). The deprecated object form {"env_merge": bool} is still accepted. GET /cvms/{cvm_id}/init-scripts shows what an existing CVM runs.

enabled_init_scripts_docker_cleanup.title: Enabled Init Scripts Docker Cleanup
enabled_init_scripts_docker_cleanup.description: Deprecated: send init_scripts: ["docker_cleanup"]. True adds docker_cleanup to init_scripts.

launch_token.title: Launch Token
launch_token.description: Launch token (at least 32 bytes) the guest requires on every boot before key provisioning. Phala Cloud writes its hash into compose_file.requirements.launch_token_hash and stores the token on the app. For an existing app it must equal the app's token. Needs dstack OS 0.6.0 or newer. Phala Cloud and the node operator can read the token: it protects only against parties who know the public compose.

generate_launch_token.title: Generate Launch Token
generate_launch_token.description: Gate the CVM with a launch token Phala Cloud generates for a new app, or with the app's existing token. A newly generated token is returned once, in the create (commit) response.

enabled_guest_agent_access.title: Enabled Guest Agent Access
enabled_guest_agent_access.description: Restrict the guest agent (port 8090) to Phala Cloud by sending false. Omit it to leave the app unchanged; a new app starts unrestricted. Sending true never relaxes an existing restriction: it is rejected with ERR-03-030 when the app is already restricted, because relaxing requires Phala Cloud support.

ssh_key_ids.title: Ssh Key Ids
ssh_key_ids.description: SSH key hashids to authorize on the new CVM. Must belong to a member of the workspace. Omit to authorize all of your own active keys.

annotations.title: Annotations
annotations.description: Opaque key/value metadata for host-side tooling, stored by the dstack VMM with the VM. Not passed to the guest, not measured, and not part of the compose hash: attestation does not cover it, so do not rely on it for security. A non-empty map requires the cvm_annotations feature flag (ERR-03-049) and a node running dstack VMM 0.6.1 or newer (ERR-03-050). Keys must not be empty. Phala Cloud keeps no copy as CVM state and never copies or restores it (a replica starts without it, a relocated CVM keeps what its VMM manifest carries); this create request is recorded in the audit log.
